title: Lapis Trails
description: Lapis Trails lets players place directional arrows with a new item, lapis chalk, color them with dyes, and light them with glow items, creating trails in caves.
body:
🟦 Lapis Trails

LapisTrail enables players to create chalk with 4 lapis, which can be used on the ground to create directional ground markers that help players navigate caves. Arrows blend into the world like a natural vanilla feature.

🎨 Recolor with Any Dye

Right-click an arrow with any vanilla dye to instantly swap it to one of 16 colors.

💡 Light Up Your Path

Use Glowstone Dust, Glow Ink Sacs, or Glow Berries to make an arrow emit a subtle light (level 8—about half a torch).
Great for marking spots in deep cave systems.

🔊 Immersive Sound Design

Placing, recoloring, and lighting arrows plays a soft bamboo-sapling hit sound.

Breaking arrows plays the rooted-dirt break sound.

🧱 Smart Placement Rules

Must be placed on the top of full blocks

Cannot float, cannot attach to walls

Automatically breaks if its supporting block is removed

Only 1 pixel tall—clean and unobtrusive

🧪 Lapis Chalk

Crafted 4 lapis → 4 chalk

Used exclusively for placing arrows.


🧩 Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.21.1

NeoForge: 21.1.x

Environment: Client & Server (required on both)

LapisTrail is designed to be lightweight and behave as close to vanilla as possible.
